object.attr: as implemented: mapped from the existing tests, with blind tests written from the requirements alone for what they missed.
object.description: On the clean machine, straight after a fresh install and before any other export, disable every network adapter, leave TECTONIC_CACHE_DIR unset, open a copy of the req-test fixture in the installed GUI and export VCU3-SRS, which has no figures, to PDF. Expected: the export succeeds, and the PDF opens and shows the document.
